about: Observation-level cannot-link constraints, reviewed from every crop in the relevant mixed entities on 2026-09-10. Groups distinguish physical objects or unmistakably different object categories; this does NOT assert that every chair in a group is the same chair. The implementation was frozen before these constraints were scored. This is a development review by the coding agent, not owner-confirmed or held-out ground truth.

cases.name: cream picture versus dark framed picture

limitations: Small or blurred crops and boxes containing both objects were excluded where the intended object was not clear.
Original mixed verdicts are preserved; excluded cases have not been relabelled clean.
Correct-association retention is evaluated separately using the 52 originally labelled clean entities.
No claim of an overall merge rate or measured position accuracy follows from these constraints.
